_README: Accumulated local ground truth for moroccoforamericans. Every entry OVERRIDES facts.json and any AI output, permanently (hard rule 8). Stage 3 loads this alongside facts.json before writing any batch.

corrections.wrong: Overstating prevalence beyond what facts.json supports — e.g. 'almost everyone / nearly everyone does the desert as a guided tour'
corrections.right: Match facts.json's register on prevalence claims. Facts say 'most first-timers take a tour with driver' and note self-driving to the dune edge is possible, so write 'most first-timers' and acknowledge the alternative — not an absolute.
